open_items: Human direction 8c951bf2af804ff1b599ad38e3aed616 r1 requires revised arrangement and mounting drawings 'using the project's applicable engineering drawing standards and GD&T framework'. No current requirement, source or model element selects a drawing or GD&T standard, and no designation, edition, applicability basis or licensed text has been supplied. The systems engineer will not infer one; AS 1100, ISO 128 with ISO 1101 and ASME Y14.5 are possibilities only, not selections. Needed from the human: the designation(s) and edition(s), and the licensed text or an authorized excerpt. Until then, drawings may use explicitly labelled provisional drafting conventions, and no compliance with any standard is claimed.

Manufacturer-supported continuous and full-mission electrical and thermal operating limits are needed for the candidate integrated module. They cover per-rotor continuous current, power, RPM, case and winding temperature, and the required ESC ratings. They must apply over the whole duty: spool-up, climb, acquisition, the uninterrupted hover of at least 300 s, descent and landing. Available catalogue data for the CR28161100 give only short-duration and nominal ratings: 20 A for 15 s per rotor, a 6–16 A efficient range, 350 W and a 65 °C maximum case temperature. These do not establish capability over the full mission.

Physical thermal endurance qualification is needed for the selected integrated module with its two ESCs and propellers. The proposed test is a restrained bench test over at least the complete nominal mission duty, logging temperature, current, voltage and RPM. It cannot be performed in this simulation-only PDR run without purchased hardware. It remains a physical test not performed, and an evidence hold on final selection and purchase. Whether PDR acceptance also requires it awaits human clarification; until then it blocks CDR only.

Paired coaxial thrust, reaction-torque, RPM and battery-current data are needed for the candidate integrated module. The data must identify the propellers, supply voltage, rotor spacing and test duration. They must be sufficient to calibrate, with stated uncertainty, the separate upper and lower interference, torque balance, differential-yaw authority and motor/ESC response. Human sourcing update e56cba0da1254955ab29bd8cdfa20ddc r1 found no qualifying paired report. Isolated-rotor data shall not be doubled. Preliminary analyses may proceed with explicitly labelled provisional models whose uncertainty is bounded. Blocking PDR follows the human statement that PDR acceptance awaits the required supporting evidence; the human is asked to confirm this.
